props.coordinates: Blender: Z up, front faces -Y, origin at ground centre

cottage.notes: Door (with brass knob and round window) faces -Y. Walls r 2.32, plinth r 2.6, roof r 3.65; only the porch/step leaves r 2.7, toward -Y to y -3.39.

market-stall.notes: Counter front and the navy energy badge (yellow bolt, tilted 40 deg back to face the camera) face -Y.

equipment-stall.notes: Counter (hat, helmet, clothes) under the teal canopy on the left; sword-and-shield board and sword barrel on the right; all face -Y.

garden-bed.notes: Soil top z 0.22, frame planks top z 0.30, corner posts z 0.335. Ridges run along X at y = +-0.4 and rise to z 0.28, so crops at (+-0.4, +-0.4) sit slightly into them.

wishing-crystal.notes: Crystal materials are emissive (Crystal, Crystal light, Crystal violet, Crystal pink); water surface at z 0.47.

storage-chest.notes: Lock plate faces -Y. Domed lid; no separate lid object (one joined mesh).

workshop.notes: Open front toward -Y; the awning covers only y >= 0.34 so the bench stays visible. Hot ingot on the anvil uses the emissive Ember material.

kitchen.notes: Emissive: Ember (glowing coals and flame bodies), Flame (flame cores and soup bubbles), Soup (soup surface at z 1.03).

well.notes: Gable roof ridge runs along Y so the gable (gold medallion) faces -Y; crank handle on +X; water surface at z 0.5.

rocket.notes: Porthole faces -Y at z 2.35. Body r <= 0.93 (porthole rim about 0.96); the four diagonal fins reach r 1.42 (inside collision r 1.5); pad r 2.64. Pad light is emissive.

fish.coordinates: Blender Z up, head toward -Y (glTF Y up, head toward +Z); metres; each model empty sits at the centre of mass; tail origin = hinge, wag about local Y (glTF)

fish_eel.note: The tail is the rear third of the body, joined by an ellipsoid of revolution; it stays sealed at +-0.6 rad but bends most naturally under ~0.35 rad.

fish_jelly.note: Bell tilted 6 degrees forward; the tail is the tentacle cluster, rooted around the hinge under the bell so any swing keeps it attached.

fish_kraken.note: Squid-style mini kraken, mantle first; the tail is five tentacles hinged at the mantle opening.

fish_golden.note: Legendary: light emissive glow, a tiny crown and a double fantail.

fish_sunfish.note: Basks on its side (rolled 85 degrees about its length, right side up) so the round body reads from the high camera and fits a shallow pond.

fish_angler.note: Emissive lure bulb on a stalk ahead of the mouth.

fish_manta.note: Tail = thin whip tail; pale shoulder marks on the dark back.

boot.note: Junk catch: an old boot with a strand of pond weed.

bobber.note: Origin at the waterline: white half below, red half above. The line anchor is the antenna tip.

lily_pad.note: Origin at the water surface; the pad top is 0.014-0.019 above it (place lily_flower there).

lily_flower.note: Origin at the flower base (its lowest point): set it on a lily_pad top (+0.016) or on the water.

reeds.note: Origin at the ground where the stems stand; four cattails and three leaves.

hero.coordinates: Blender Z up, explorer facing -Y (glTF Y up, facing +Z); metres; part origins are hero_spec.PIVOTS; disguise pieces are modelled in explorer space at rest pose

wear.coordinates: Explorer space (hero_spec.py): Blender Z up, the explorer faces -Y (glTF Y up, faces +Z); metres; standing at the origin, arms hanging straight down. Each item is an empty named the id at the origin; its meshes end with @<part>, the hero part they follow, and keep their world transform when reparented.

armor_wings.label: Dragon wings
armor_wings.note: Wings spread from behind the backpack (roots at y 0.47); the vest has no sleeves.

armor_kimono.label: Kimono
armor_kimono.note: Wide hanging sleeves (z 0.77-1.09); the obi bow sits under the backpack.

armor_superhero.label: Superhero outfit
armor_superhero.note: The cape drapes over the backpack (clear of it); hiding the backpack is optional.

armor_angel.label: Angel outfit
armor_angel.note: Small feathered wings behind the backpack (roots at y 0.47).

armor_hoodie.label: Hoodie
armor_hoodie.note: The hood lies down behind the neck, on top of the backpack.

boots_rocket.label: Rocket boots
boots_rocket.note: The thruster points back and down from the heel; flame and glow are emissive.

boots_lava.label: Lava boots
boots_lava.note: Faceted basalt with emissive cracks and a glowing sole rim.

weapons.coordinates: Blender Z up, explorer faces -Y (glTF Y up, faces +Z); metres; weapons in explorer space gripped at hand-right; pets stand at the origin facing -Y

poses.note: muzzle/rod-tip empties have no rotation; shots travel along the explorer's facing

pets.flap: wings: rotate <id>_wing_l / <id>_wing_r about their own forward axis (glTF Z, Blender Y), opposite signs; about +-0.6 rad reads as a flap. _r is on +X like hand-right.

items.coordinates: Blender Z up, front toward -Y (glTF Y up, front toward +Z); metres; one top-level mesh per id, base at z 0, centred on the origin
